title: We Are Testing You
subtitle: Advice to those dealing with patients.
text: I am usually writing these columns from my perch as a psychiatrist, and a distinguished-ish one at that. However, I have been one with an illness. I’m a…patient. Today’s article is very much from that vantage point, to explain to other health professionals how those of us who are patients think. This is not restricted to psychiatric illness, but i…
